official.name: English
official.note: co-official; license plates have been bilingual Arabic/English since 2009

terrainDescription.zh: 北部為努比亞沙漠與撒哈拉邊緣，中部逐漸過渡為半乾燥草原，南部近邊界地帶轉為稀樹草原。
terrainDescription.en: Nubian desert and Sahara fringe in the north, transitioning through semi-arid steppe in the center to savanna near the southern border.

plate.color: white background, bilingual Arabic/English text; letter prefix indicates the issuing state (e.g. خ/KH for Khartoum)

historicalContext.zh: 阿拉伯語與英語同為官方語言，車牌自2009年起採阿拉伯語／英語雙語並列格式，與2011年後以英語為唯一官方語言的南蘇丹形成語言辨識上的對照。
historicalContext.en: Arabic and English are both official; license plates have used a bilingual Arabic/English format since 2009 — a useful contrast with neighboring South Sudan, which has used English as its sole official language since 2011.
